Bridge and tree cases, scalar field, graph simplicity and normalization are explicit; the finite atlas computation is supplementary, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The result gives a sharp topology-dependent stability discontinuity for the ordinary orthogonal projection of inconsistent edge data to global gradients: no cyclic graph has amplification between 1 and 4/3. The complete equality classification and exact cactus formula are natural structural invariants of an operator widely used in Hodge regression, with explicit worst-case noise witnesses; the contribution is not a renaming, a finite table, or an arbitrary parameter slice.
